policy.label: Basel: BVB/BLT and Swiss-side regional rail

roadExclusions.note: The 50 m station-candidate profile doubles back along the approach from the provisional General Guisan-Strasse stop. The official plan instead continues around the southern loop to St. Galler-Ring. Do not accept the shortcut.

exclusions: Long-distance and regional-express rail; S5, S9, RB27 and RB30
Rail calls beyond Laufen, Sissach, Rheinfelden, Riehen and Basel St. Johann
Other local operators, including AAGL, SWEG and distribus; this is not complete TNW or trireno

scope.sourceCallSemantics: Every local source call retained; rail keeps contiguous in-scope source calls only, with zero-based half-open sourceCallRange and full sourceCallCount. No calendar or coordinate clipping hides intermediate calls.

infrastructure.inference: Undirected physical centreline corridors through exact FOT operating-point identities. Running tracks are not resolved.

tlmRoad.reviewBoundary: Inferred road centreline through Freilager and Neapel-Strasse, not surveyed temporary lane or kerb geometry.

tram6.note: Heuwaage via Markthalle to Zoo Bachletten. Outbound Markthalle is passed without a call. Closed Holbeinstrasse corridor excluded.

bus33.note: Continue south from the provisional General Guisan-Strasse stop, then Neubadstrasse and St. Galler-Ring. No return along the approach or earlier side-street shortcut.

bus34.note: October 2025 BVB plan: replacement edge A on Hörnliallee to edge B on Kohlistieg via the connecting bus carriageway.

ev11.note: BLT dated construction map confirms the Neapel-Strasse–Ruchfeldstrasse corridor toward Aesch. Schaulager–MFP uses OSM. Freilager–Schaulager uses a continuous independent swissTLM3D road chain, including the northern 4m road omitted from the OSM motor-road graph. The largest separation from the dated BLT corridor is 25.6m; this is a schematic centreline inference, not the exact temporary carriageway. The direct Emil Frey-Strasse shortcut and the earlier Genuastrasse turn remain excluded.

depotCorridors.note: Dated network plan establishes open tram corridors; exact full ordered platform patterns from GTFS 20260905 establish these depot/special journeys on the two reviewed civil dates. Continuous official line features and explicitly reviewed TLM junction chains only. Closed Claraplatz–Dreirosenbrücke and Holbeinstrasse corridors excluded.

stopPlans.note: March 2026: platform H faces east toward Hardstrasse. Rejected an undirected candidate that arrived facing west after an unnecessary loop.
7 September–23 October 2026: northern platform C connects east toward Brombacherstrasse. Rejected an undirected candidate turning west and reversing at a switch.
